title: Run a Python app temporarily without installing it
summary: Use pipx to run a Python application in a temporary virtual environment. This is useful for trying out tools without permanently installing them.

steps.explain: Run the specified Python package in a temporary virtual environment. The environment is deleted after the command finishes.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: The name of the Python package to run

placeholders.name: ARGS
placeholders.description: Arguments to pass to the application

steps.expect: The application runs and outputs its result.

steps.explain: If the executable name differs from the package name, use --spec to specify the package and then the executable.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: The name of the Python package containing the executable

placeholders.name: EXECUTABLE
placeholders.description: The name of the executable to run

placeholders.name: ARGS
placeholders.description: Arguments to pass to the executable

steps.expect: The specified executable runs with the given arguments.
